subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should proactive fallback-chain verification be an ordered mode of `openclaw models status --probe`, or a separate `/models test-fallback` command?
rationale: The missing capability and runtime boundary are clear, but maintainers must choose one durable public command contract and settle its overlap with the broader configured-model health proposal.

options.title: Extend status probe
options.body: Add an explicit ordered fallback-chain scope to the established diagnostics command and share its output, JSON, timeout, concurrency, and authentication contracts.

options.title: Dedicated fallback command
options.body: Add a narrow action whose sole contract is to skip the primary and test one or all configured fallback candidates.

options.title: Defer proactive requests
options.body: Keep authentication probes and runtime failover only, avoiding diagnostic model calls and their cost and rate-limit impact.

recommendation.title: Extend status probe
recommendation.body: Add an explicit ordered fallback-chain scope to the established diagnostics command and share its output, JSON, timeout, concurrency, and authentication contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: He already provided the most concrete product review for this exact request and has recent history in the affected fallback and status surfaces.
